records.source_span: Sir Winfried Bischoff has been Chairman of the FRC since May 2014
records.claim: Sir Winfried Bischoff is Chairman of the Financial Reporting Council.

records.source_span: Other board members include Gay Huey Evans, Melanie McLaren and Paul George
records.value: Gay Huey Evans, Melanie McLaren, Paul George
records.claim: Gay Huey Evans, Melanie McLaren, and Paul George are board members of the FRC.

records.source_span: In 2019, Simon Dingemans and Sir Jon Thompson took over as chair and CEO respectively
